synset.attribution: © 2024 Fraunhofer IOSB. Publisher names and reference links are retained. The national-code and classifier correspondences are local adaptations.
synset.review: National codes match the federal designation, face and printed values. Classifier targets follow reviewed training-crop semantics. A null target preserves a source sign without a verified classifier match.

reviewed_classifier.scope: Pinned classifier vocabulary only; class availability does not establish calibrated detection, end-to-end recognition, legal applicability, or runtime action approval.

mapillary.review: German literal source IDs cover the existing aliases, the Baden-Württemberg inventory and published numeric g1 speed variants. target_label records classifier membership. A null target with excluded_de records an out-of-scope German source ID. Other null targets await a match. The reference_only status identifies approved targets outside the deployed vocabulary. mapping_basis describes the visual evidence. National sign identity is reviewed independently.
